en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobbled town square with a large historic building in the center, featuring a steep tiled roof, dormer windows, a small central clock above a balcony, and a tower with a weather vane. Signs on the façade read "Stadt‑Sparkasse" and "Rathskeller," indicating a city savings bank and town hall cellar/restaurant. Several people and dogs stand in the square, with period streetlamps and additional multi‑story townhouses lining the far side of the square, one bearing the sign "A. Gentzsch." The architecture and signage suggest a small German town in the early 20th century.
